Bash: cat > work/check.json <<'EOF'
{
  "format": 1,
  "rule": "req~accessibility.custom-view-labels~1",
  "example": "the folded marker",
  "files": {
    "reaper.md": "Notes from Tuesday.\n\n## Fix the reaper\nThe reaper leaves zombie processes behind.\nRestart it when it exits.\n"
  },
  "steps": [
    {"line": "* Given a notebook with \"## Fix the reaper\" folded is open",
     "do": [{"launch": {"build": "debug", "inspector": true}},
            {"drive": ["menu", "File > Open…"]},
            {"drive": ["choose", {"file": "reaper.md"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"drive": ["menu", "View > Fold All"]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "folded"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".folded.json.sections.notebook.folded | map(.line) == [\"## Fix the reaper\"]",
                 "why": "\"## Fix the reaper\" is the one folded heading"},
                {"that": "(.folded.json.sections.notebook.folded[0].offset) as $h | .folded.json.sections.notebook.drawn | any(.offset == $h and (.text | startswith(\"## Fix the reaper\")))",
                 "why": "the notebook is open in the window with the folded heading shown"}]},
    {"line": "* When the window's accessibility tree is read",
     "do": [{"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "shown"},
            {"drive": ["tree"], "as": "tree"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".tree.elements | length > 0",
                 "why": "the window's accessibility tree was read"}]},
    {"line": "* Then the folded marker of \"## Fix the reaper\" has the label \"Folded\"",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": "(.shown.json.sections.notebook.folded[] | select(.line == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .offset) as $h | [.shown.json.sections.notebook.markers[] | select(.heading == $h)] | length == 1",
                 "why": "the window shows the folded marker beside \"## Fix the reaper\""},
                {"that": "def near($a; $b): ($a - $b) as $d | (if $d < 0 then -$d else $d end) <= 1; (.shown.json.sections.notebook.folded[] | select(.line == \"## Fix the reaper\") | .offset) as $h | (.shown.json.sections.notebook.markers[] | select(.heading == $h) | .rect) as $m | .shown.json.window.content.height as $ch | (.tree.elements | min_by(.depth) | .frame) as $w | ($w[0] + $m.x) as $x | ($w[1] + $w[3] - $ch + $m.y) as $y | [.tree.elements[] | select((.frame | type) == \"array\") | select(near(.frame[0]; $x) and near(.frame[1]; $y) and near(.frame[2]; $m.width) and near(.frame[3]; $m.height))] | length > 0 and any(.[]; .label == \"Folded\")",
                 "why": "the accessibility element at the marker's place, placed from the tree's window frame, is labeled \"Folded\""}]}
  ]
}
EOF
bin/palantir-accept lint work/check.json rule.md
